title: fluorostats: deterministic, CPU-only quantification of fluorescence microscopy
description:
fluorostats is an open-source Python library and command-line tool for quantifying fluorescence microscopy images and volumes. Every metric is a deterministic, training-free, CPU-only function of its inputs: repeated runs return identical bits, and no step holds a learned weight or draws a random seed.

The library spans 2D coverage and 3D volume fraction, connectivity and topology (Euler number, connected components), skeleton and vascular network metrics, per-object morphometry, annular/tube morphometry, network organisation, spatial heterogeneity, depth-resolved viability, and 3D rendering. It integrates a statistics layer that general imaging platforms omit, including non-parametric tests with effect sizes, stratified and interaction tests, Benjamini-Hochberg multiplicity control, bootstrap confidence intervals, agreement statistics and bootstrap power analysis, so that quantification and inference never leave the same pipeline.

Every metric, and the scoring code used to benchmark it, is validated against a canonical reference implementation or against analytic ground truth. This deposit is the exact version used in the accompanying manuscript, and includes the full benchmark harness with pinned dependencies.
